messages:
maya: Heads-up — ran into a weird edge-case in Console where user YAML with merge keys produces a different effective route order than the author expects. Lint passes locally but the runtime rejects the config on deploy. Anyone seen this?

aj: hm. Can you paste a minimal repro? sounds like merge/anchor behavior.

maya: yeah repro below. In this gist the author tries to reuse a default matcher and merge in a header matcher. Locally safe_load -> ok, but server says 'duplicate route' on apply.

maya: ```yaml
_defaults: &base
  priority: 10
  matchers:
    - path: /api/*
      headers:
        x-env: prod
routes:
  - <<: *base
    id: route-a
  - id: route-b
    priority: 5
    matchers:
      - path: /api/special
```

maya: Author expects route-a then route-b. But server seems to flatten the merge and reorder matchers so route-b wins.

kevin: that smells like our canonicalization step. When we normalize the YAML to json before validation we sort keys to make diffs stable — maybe the merge expands in a different order. What YAML parser are they using locally?

maya: they used python yaml.safe_load in the repro. Our server uses ruamel.yaml for the Console import flow.

aj: ruamel vs pyyaml do treat merges differently (esp. with sequence merging). Also we historically have a post-processing step that dedups matchers across routes. Could be double-handling.

schema-lint-bot: lint result for 1718604321: config-schema-v2: PASS. normalization-check: WARN (merge-anchors detected).

aj: interesting the linter passes because it validates schema after merge, but the runtime fails during routing-index build. So two different code paths.

kevin: quick thought: when we expand anchors we should preserve author ordering for routes array and only canonicalize within route objects. If we globally sort keys, arrays may get reshuffled if we accidentally treat arrays as sets.

sophia: agreed. UX-wise we should also warn in Console when anchor/merge keys are present and explain subtle behavior. Many users rely on anchors to share snippets and not realize expansion happens server-side.

nora: can someone point to the exact function that does normalization? I can add a unit test once we have a failing case.

aj: normalization lives in eng-platform/pkg/config/normalize.go -> NormalizeConfig. I can add a small test that loads a YAML with merge keys and asserts stable route order after NormalizeConfig.

maya: thx. My repro file already included an example and expected order. I'll paste it into the repo as fixtures/merge-ordering.yaml.

kevin: also check our Console import path: it goes through the JS preview first (yaml->json in the browser using js-yaml) and then the server does ruamel expansion. So three parsers in play: js-yaml, pyyaml/ruamel, and our normalization. That mismatch explains why local safe_load looked fine.

aj: ugh. So fix options: 1) Do deterministic expansion in server that preserves array order. 2) Add a normalization step in the Console JS preview so users see exactly what the server will expand. 3) Linter warning/hint. We should do all three but prioritize tests + server fix.

sophia: prioritize UX: add immediate warning in Console about anchors and a quick 'Preview expanded YAML' button showing server-side expansion (maybe call a dry-run endpoint).

nora: I'll own a small test matrix: js-yaml vs ruamel vs server-normalize on a couple of merge patterns (map merge, sequence merge, nested anchors). Will add to eng-platform CI.

aj: I'll open a PR to make expansion deterministic in NormalizeConfig and add a regression test using maya's fixture.

maya: thanks. I'll also add a Console UX issue for the preview button + anchor warning. Tagging @product for prioritization. :thumbsup:

kevin: small note — watch out for yaml merge that intentionally duplicates matchers across routes (we dedup later). We should ensure dedupe preserves the first-seen route ordering semantics (author intent).

maya: agreed. For now we can treat this as a bug: server reorder on merge = surprising.

aj: timeline: PR today for tests + normalization change, Console warning in next sprint.

schema-lint-bot: test-run queued: eng-platform CI (merge-ordering)

kevin: thanks team. Pinging infra to avoid deploy surprises.

nora: added testcase checklist in the issue: js-yaml, ruamel, pyyaml safe_load. Will report back with failing matrix.

maya: awesome — I'll paste the fixture and link to this thread in the issue.

aj: assigning to aj, nora, and sophia.

maya: done. Closing the loop here, appreciate the quick triage. :sparkles:
